scraped.title: Market oriented value chains
scraped.subtitle: CPE of the project "Market oriented value chains for jobs and growth in the ECOWAS region"
scraped.description: The aim of the stand-alone regional project “Market Oriented Value Chains for Jobs and Growth in the ECOWAS Region (MOVE)” is to improve the living conditions of 80,000 rice and cashew producers in selected West African countries and to enhance the competitiveness of locally…
body: The aim of the stand-alone regional project “Market Oriented Value Chains for Jobs and Growth in the ECOWAS Region (MOVE)” is to improve the living conditions of 80,000 rice and cashew producers in selected West African countries and to enhance the competitiveness of locally produced rice and cashews to meet the growing regional demand. It focuses on building resilient market-oriented cashew and rice value chains to create income and employment opportunities in West Africa, with the ECOWAS as its main political partner.

ICON was commissioned to conduct the central project evaluation (CPE) for the project. The evaluation uses the GIZ results model to develop a theory of change allowing to formulate five critical change hypotheses and assessing causal pathways, underlying assumptions, and potential risks. The evaluation considerers all OECD DAC criteria and foresees a remote inception and in-person evaluation mission in Nigeria and Burkina Faso. The methodology includes:
contribution analysis with revision of the results model
remote and in-person key informant interviews as well as focus group discussions and desk review • efficiency analysis with follow the money approach
multi-stakeholder perspectives from beneficiaries, partners, staff to experts and public informants
rigorous triangulation across informant, type of source and evaluator
